TripPlanList
TripPlanList · Trips/TripPlanList.swift
The plan as day sections of stops and connectors, with drag and drop; an inset list on the list ground.
Non-selectable rows
Banners, connectors, Add Stop, the caption and the attribution are not selectable. Only stop rows select.

Drop indicator
A 2 pt (stroke/thick) capsule in accent/primary at the top of the target row, day header or Add Stop row. Shown on the Day 2 header and its Add Stop row.
